card.name: Number words before a hyphenated fraction
card.fires_on: The word "one" right after an opening parenthesis following a mg dose, as in "(one-half tablet)". Also the ending "y" of tens words like Seventy or Eighty, just before a hyphen.

modes.label: One in dose parentheses
modes.description: "one" opens a parenthetical that restates a dose as a tablet amount, often "one-half".

modes.label: Tens words before a hyphen
modes.description: The "y" ending of a tens number such as seventy or eighty, before a hyphenated number.

card.writes: It promotes hyphenated number continuations such as "-third", "-six", "-four" and "-degree", so it predicts a hyphen and number part next.
card.plain: It fires on a number word that is about to be joined by a hyphen, like "one-half tablet" or "seventy-one".
